physics-killer-04.material: Ibhola ikhutshwa ngokuthe tye esiphethweni somqolo ophakame $20\,\mathrm{m}$ kwaye ifike emhlabeni emgama othe tye $30\,\mathrm{m}$ ukusuka emqolweni. Xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kwaye ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa isantya sebhola ngexesha lokuchukumisa umhlaba kunye ne-$\tan\theta$ ye-engile $\theta$ eyenziwa licala lesantya kunye nomgangatho othe tye ngokulandelelana?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: Ibhola ikhutshwa ngokuthe tye esiphethweni somqolo ophakame $20\,\mathrm{m}$ kwaye ifike emhlabeni emgama othe tye $30\,\mathrm{m}$ ukusuka emqolweni. Xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kwaye ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa isantya sebhola ngexesha lokuchukumisa umhlaba kunye ne-$\tan\theta$ ye-engile $\theta$ eyenziwa licala lesantya kunye nomgangatho othe tye ngokulandelelana?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Icala elithe nkqo $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Icala elithe tye $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kanye ngaphambi kokufika emhlabeni $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Ukuba isantya sidityaniswa ne $v_0+gt=35$, impendulo engalunganga ①, ukuba $\tan\theta$ ibhalwe ngokuphikisana, kuba $\frac34$ (impendulo engalunganga ②), ukuba kusetyenziswa kuphela icandelo elithe nkqo $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ njengesantya, ngumphendulo ongalunganga ④.
